children: Slovakia’s consumer confidence indicator fell to -28 in August 2026 from -27.4 in the previous month, marking its lowest level since May.
The reading was 8.1 points below the long-term average and 3.6 points lower than a year earlier, pointing to a further deterioration in consumer sentiment.
That was due increased pessimism about unemployment prospects and expected savings.
Meanwhile, households were slightly more optimistic about their expected financial situation and the broader economic outlook.

title: Slovakia Consumer Confidence Weakens Further
